title: Editable Blur and Pixelation
summary: Draw rectangular visual effects, change their intensity live, and keep regions editable when saving your project.

Added: More > Blur creates editable rectangular Blur or Pixelate regions.
Selected regions offer Type and live Intensity controls with one Undo per released adjustment.
Move and resize effect regions using their canvas handles; save and reopen them as editable objects.
Verified: Shared renderer handles transparency, stacked objects and unchanged pixels outside the effect region.
Native creation, type switching, intensity Undo/Redo, movement, resizing, saved projects and clipboard output pass synthetic checks.
Pixelation matches an independent block-average calculation across a complete saved image.

limitations: Visual effects are not a secure-redaction guarantee. Editable projects retain original pixels; use solid Redact and flattened export when appropriate.
Only rectangular effect regions are implemented. Ellipse regions, effect Quick Styles and Smart Redact remain unfinished.
This unsigned historical alpha covers only the workflows verified in its release notes.
